selected_process_card: Card 17 - The Object Is A Receipt
public_hook: Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house.
reader_identity_mirror: Couples who travel with impossible confidence, too many backups, and still forget the obvious thing.
emotional_obstacle: Packing could expose one organized person versus one chaotic person. The fresh turn is that both are chaotic in different categories, so the joke belongs to the relationship, not one partner.
aachu_specific_proof: She packs 'just options' with full confidence: outfits, dupatta/shawl choices, and imaginary-weather backup.
zuv_specific_proof: He packs chargers, cables, power banks, and backup gadgets with equal seriousness.
mutual_active_role: They both sit on the suitcase, both forget the toothbrushes, and both blame the zip.
earned_ending: Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
send_save_reason: A viewer can tag the partner who says 'we might need this' while also being guilty themselves.
slide_copy: Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house.
He packed chargers for gadgets they don't own.
Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
